Second Life Town - Time Lapse Building Movie

Andy CASA, UCL East

A student from East Michigan University, going under the name of lordflydigeridoo on YouTube, has posted a movie detailing the construction of a town in Second Life.

The video runs as a time lapse showing a weeks work over a period of 6min and 43 seconds.



It provides an interesting insight into building in Second Life - note the Google Earth image drape before the project starts.

A higher quality clip can be viewed from here.
